title: Finite Gaussian blocks form a compatible countable product probability tower

projective_tower.coordinates: A countable sequence of real Gaussian coordinates, with charged complex coordinates represented by charge-stable real two-planes and based-gauge coordinates kept as a separate Gaussian factor
projective_tower.finite_measures: gamma_N is the product of the first N normalized standard Gaussian coordinate measures
projective_tower.consistency: For M>=N, coordinate projection pi_MN pushes gamma_M exactly to gamma_N and pi_LN=pi_MN composed with pi_LM
projective_tower.continuum_measure: Kolmogorov product measure gamma_infinity exists on the countable product sigma-algebra and has every gamma_N as its finite marginal
projective_tower.martingale: Conditional expectations E_N onto the first-N sigma-algebra are contractive orthogonal projections and E_N f converges to f in L2(gamma_infinity)
projective_tower.boundary: The countable product is a repository-owned Gaussian probability control. It is not translation invariant along the Cameron-Martin space, a measure on a declared nonlinear field configuration space, or a source-derived path-integral measure
